// Generates the 256-Key Mode (`.lup` version 6) migration fixture of V09-S06
// with PlumSpirit v0.9 as it was before clips existed (commit aff02e9): built
// here, saved by that writer, hashed by that build. v0.9 with clips opens it
// as one identity clip per track with every hash equal and rewrites it byte
// for byte (`tests/v09_clip_migration.rs`).
//
// Run inside an aff02e9 checkout (copied into crates/plumspirit_engine/src/,
// declared `#[cfg(test)] mod v09_keys_fixture_gen;` in lib.rs):
//   V08_FIXTURE_OUT=/path/to/tests/fixtures/v08 \
//     cargo test --release -p plumspirit_engine --lib v09_keys_fixture_gen -- --ignored --nocapture

use crate::model::project::{Bpm, KeyRange};
use crate::model::track::{TrackKind, TrackProps};
use crate::model::{NoteAttrs, NoteOffKind, NoteRecord, NoteStore, PlumDocument, SubchannelId};
use crate::native::project_to_bytes;

include!("../tests/fixtures/v08/semantic_hashes.rs");

#[test]
#[ignore]
fn make_v09_keys_fixture() {
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("V08_FIXTURE_OUT").expect("V08_FIXTURE_OUT"));
    let mut d = PlumDocument::new_project("256 keys (v0.9 before clips)".into(), Bpm::DEFAULT, 960);
    d.project_mut().keys = KeyRange::Extended256;
    d.add_track().unwrap();
    for ti in 0..2usize {
        let notes: Vec<NoteRecord> = (0..2048u64)
            .map(|k| NoteRecord {
                start_tick: k * 30,
                duration_ticks: 25 + (k % 7) * 10,
                attrs: NoteAttrs::new_wide(
                    ((k * 37 + ti as u64 * 11) % 256) as u8,
                    1 + (k % 127) as u8,
                    (k % 16) as u8,
                    (k % 128) as u8,
                    NoteOffKind::NoteOff,
                )
                .unwrap()
                .with_muted(k % 31 == 0),
                sub: SubchannelId(0),
                group: 0,
            })
            .collect();
        let t = d.track_mut(ti).unwrap();
        t.notes = NoteStore::from_sorted_records(&notes, false).unwrap();
    }
    let t = d.track_mut(1).unwrap();
    let end = t.end_of_track_tick;
    let props = TrackProps {
        kind: TrackKind::Melody,
        key_correction: -200,
        key_range: (3, 250),
        ..t.props().clone()
    };
    t.set_props(props, end);
    let bytes = project_to_bytes(&d).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(u16::from_le_bytes([bytes[8], bytes[9]]), 6);
    let (back, _) = crate::native::project_from_bytes(&bytes).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hashes_text(&back), hashes_text(&d));
    std::fs::write(out.join("keys256_v09.lup"), &bytes).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(out.join("keys256_v09.hashes"), hashes_text(&d)).unwrap();
    println!("keys256_v09: {} notes, {} bytes", d.note_count(), bytes.len());
}
